title: Standard BioTools Dynamic Array 96.96: Load 4 uL
author: Standard BioTools

steps.title: Select workflow and prepare plates
steps.instruction: Choose the appropriate workflow from the Standard BioTools X9 User Guide (Gene Expression with TaqMan, Genotyping with SNP Type, or Genotyping with TaqMan) and prepare the sample and assay plates accordingly.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 6 µL of each sample to all wells of a 96‑well plate.
Transfer 6 µL of each assay to all wells of a separate 96‑well plate.
Verify that every well (blue‑indicated in the guide) contains liquid.
Centrifuge both the sample and assay plates briefly to bring liquids to the bottom of the wells.

steps.title: Prepare the 96.96 IFC
steps.instruction: Ready the Integrated Fluidic Circuit for loading.

substeps.instruction: Add control line fluid to the accumulators as specified for the selected workflow (red‑arrowed in the guide).
Remove the protective film from the bottom of the IFC.

steps.title: Load assays onto left side
steps.instruction: Transfer 4 µL of each assay from the assay plate to the corresponding left‑side wells of the 96.96 IFC.

steps.title: Load samples onto right side
steps.instruction: Transfer 4 µL of each sample from the sample plate to the corresponding right‑side wells of the 96.96 IFC.
